question.problem:
From top to bottom, what are the missing expressions in the following polynomial division problem?

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\boxed{} \\  & x+2\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,{x}^{2}+0x-9} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{{x}^{2}+2x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,-2x-9 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,{\boxed{}}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,-5\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
Notice that the dividend is missing the $x$-term. So, we write it using a zero coefficient, as follows:

$$
{x}^{2}+0x-9
$$

Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,x-2 \\  & x+2\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,{x}^{2}+0x-9} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{{x}^{2}+2x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,-2x-9 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,{-\,2x-4}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,-5\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the missing expressions are

$\,$ $x-2\,$ and $\,-2x-4.$
